column1: # FROZEN R1..R6 MEANINGS (verbatim from the canonical source:
# c2-ranked-candidates.tsv -- the last ACT that froze them).
#   R1 SELFHOST_STAGE_LEVERAGE    0 blocks the next self-host stage; 1 unlocks
#   R2 SEMANTIC_CENTRALITY        0 single function / tight component;
#                                 1 existing direct oracle; 2 easy bounded oracle;
#                                 3 metamorphic only; 4 weak or no oracle
#   R4 DEPENDENCY_COUPLING_COST   mechanical count of direct helper deps +
#   R5 MIGRATION_SIZE             1 small fixture matrix + simple differential;
#   R6 SOURCE_ORDER               file lexical asc, then line_start asc
# RECON01/RECON02 additionally used R5 as a 0/1 flag on the same
# dimension: 0 = a PURE SCALAR-DOMAIN decision whose proof is a direct
# value-in/value-out differential; 1 = a decision whose INPUT DOMAIN is
# not a plain scalar (token-kind records, text buffers, recursive trees),
# so the fixture matrix is larger than a scalar matrix.  This ACT keeps
# that historical 0/1 usage for scalar-domain candidates and uses the
# 1..5 scale for the non-scalar ones.  The two usages never overlap on
# a candidate, so the ordering is preserved.
# R6 is encoded as the literal string "<file>:<line_start>", exactly as
# RECON02 (c2-ranked-candidates.tsv) encoded it, and is ordered by file
# lexical asc then line_start asc.  No new column, no new weight and no
# silent redefinition of any historical column was introduced (AC21).
# Schema: candidate_id <TAB> R0 <TAB> R1 <TAB> R2 <TAB> R3 <TAB> R4 <TAB> R5 <TAB> R6 <TAB> eligible <TAB> rationale
